fields.Name: AIUsageCacheEfficiency
fields.UserQuestion: What is our prompt caching hit rate and estimated cost savings across models and prompts?
fields.Description: Prompt cache efficiency per model and prompt (and currency): cache read volume, cache read share, and estimated savings priced at the token rate in effect when each run executed, with a count of runs that could not be rated.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Groups vwAIUsageFacts by ModelID, PromptID and CostCurrency (parallel parents excluded). Each run is priced by the AIModelCost row in effect at RunAt (StartedAt <= RunAt < EndedAt, Active or Expired, Realtime) matched on model, vendor and currency, restricted to token-billed unit types (AIModelPriceUnitType.UsageTypeID = Tokens) and divided by UnitsPerBillingUnit. Runs with no matching rate or a NULL CacheReadPricePerUnit are excluded from EstimatedSavings and counted in UnratedRuns / UnratedTokensCacheRead. Optional start/end filter the base RunAt column.
